title: Implement ADR-0063/0064: split ask/build agents by surface; tool scoping
body:
Implementation tracking for **[ADR-0063](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/blob/main/docs/adr/0063-two-kernel-agents-skills-are-the-extension-primitive.md)** (two agents bound by surface) and **[ADR-0064](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/blob/main/docs/adr/0064-tool-scoping-to-agent.md)** (tool scoping). Decision PR: #2167. Landscape: `docs/audits/2026-06-ask-build-agent-development-assessment.md`.

### Split the personas (reverse ADR-0040 unified assistant)
- [x] Remove the unified `ask`-carries-all-skills definition + per-turn intent preamble (`service-ai/src/agents/data-chat-agent.ts`); `ask` carries only `surface:'ask'` skills.
- [x] Delete the `buildRegisterActive` degradation shim (`service-ai/src/agent-runtime.ts:179`) — no longer needed once surfaces are separate.
- [x] Bind agent → surface in `../objectui` (data console → `ask`, Studio → `build`); keep the picker hidden/builder-only.

### Naming (finish both sides of the rename)
- [x] `service-ai/src/agents/data-chat-agent.ts` → `ask-agent.ts`; `DEFAULT_DATA_AGENT_NAME` → `ASK_AGENT_NAME` (keep `LEGACY_DATA_AGENT_NAME='data_chat'`).
- [x] `../cloud/service-ai-studio`: make `build` the **canonical** id (currently still `metadata_assistant`); register `metadata_assistant` as the permanent alias.
- [x] Prose sweep: "Data/Metadata Assistant" → `ask`/`build`; aliases live only in the alias table.

### Skill ↔ agent affinity (ADR-0063 §3)
- [x] Add `surface: 'ask' | 'build' | 'both'` to `SkillSchema` (`spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`); backfill the four built-in skills.

### Tool scoping (ADR-0064)
- [x] Remove the global fall-through in tool resolution; resolve wildcards against skill-claimed names only (kill the `actions_executor` empty-array + fall-through hack).
- [x] Add a `surface:'both'` `schema_reader` skill owning `describe_object`/`list_objects`/`query_data`; stop dual-listing by comment.
- [x] Make incompatible skill↔agent binding a fast load error in `resolveActiveSkills`.
- [x] Tests: `tools(ask)` contains no `create_*`/`*_metadata`/blueprint tools (cloud + OSS); authoring tools present only under `build`.

### Withdraw tenant custom agents (ADR-0063 §2)
- [x] `spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`: set `agent` type `allowRuntimeCreate:false, allowOrgOverride:false`.
- [x] Filter custom agents from the runtime catalog; drop the `app.defaultAgent` custom-agent guidance in the cloud plugin.

### Deferred
- D4 deployment guardrail-floor schema — defer (no tenant agent to floor once the above lands).
